selected_evidence.requirement: TCP 8081 web service is reachable through loopback but not through the external interface
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, the listener is exclusively 127.0.0.1:8081, loopback HTTP returns the expected page, and 10.100.55.10:8081 refuses the connection.

selected_evidence.requirement: Service is enabled and running persistently
selected_evidence.summary: The service was enabled and active when installed and remained enabled and active after reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart and recovery sequence
selected_evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID e31962a9-8d32-4c19-8dd2-0b96a45c6c48 was captured, the safe reboot was acknowledged, the new boot ID a41e7a7d-20f1-4941-b23b-debdb55dfc05 proved a node restart, and direct post-restart checks proved service and content recovery.

cat > /etc/systemd/system/loopback-web.service <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Loopback-only web service on TCP 8081
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
DynamicUser=yes
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -m http.server 8081 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory /var/www/loopback-only
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2s
NoNewPrivileges=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0644 /etc/systemd/system/loopback-web.service
systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/loopback-web.service
systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable --now loopback-web.service && systemctl is-enabled loopback-web.service && systemctl is-active loopback-web.service
